data.value: Azure AD tenant (id or domain) for the portal link, when it is not your default

data.value: URL template instead of the portal: {placeholders}

data.value: plugins.{plugin}.{key} is not an absolute URL: {url}

data.value: No Application Insights in this subscription; set one: azsb config set plugins.{plugin}.{key} <resource id>
